item.title: Help arrives for Mississippi communities after Winter Storm Fern
item.description: The propane industry came together in northern Mississippi, where ice accumulations of up to 4 in. knocked out power for weeks for some. <p>The post Help arrives for Mississippi communities after Winter Storm Fern first appeared on LP Gas.</p>

item.title: Nexio discusses vision for high-power, low-emission propane fleets
item.description: During the 2025 LP Gas Growth Summit, Nexio outlined how it is utilizing its decades of propane engine experience to provide a safer, propane-powered delivery truck and add new fuel applications to help the industry burn more gallons. <p>The post Nexio discusses vision for high-power, low-emission propane fleets first appeared on LP Gas.</p>
